newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: China WTO membership said to hinge on open market.
newsitem.headline: China WTO membership said to hinge on open market.

text.p: Renato Ruggiero, the Director- General of the World Trade Organization (WTO) said Wednesday Chinese membership of the trade body hinges on the successful outcome of talks on market access which are nearing their conclusion.

"If the market access negotiations will be concluded in a satisfactory way then I think at that point we can be really optimistic of the chances of China entering the WTO in a reasonable period of time," Ruggiero told Reuters, while attending a Mercosur meeting in Asuncion.
"Do not ask me what a reasonable period of time will be but I can tell you we have entered or are approaching the final stage of the negotiations," on market access, Ruggiero added.
He said market access was now the key issue of talks.
On other issues such as intellectual property "a lot of progress" has been made with China. "They are committed to implementing the intellectual property legislation upon accession," Ruggiero said.
China has been seeking to join the global trade body ever since it was first established in 1995.
